title: Universal Visual Botanical Profiler
description: Field identification and toxicology profiling template for vascular plant classification and safety processing.
content:
Act as an expert field botanist, toxicologist, and ethnobotanist. Analyze the following visual parameters observed in the target plant image to build an instant, high-fidelity botanical profiling blueprint.

1. OBSERVATION MATRIX & TAXONOMY
- Primary Visual Indicators: Leaf arrangement is {{Leaf Arrangement|*Alternate, Opposite, Whorled, Basal Rosette}} with leaf margins classified as {{Leaf Margin Type|*Entire/Smooth, Serrated/Toothed, Lobed, Undulate/Wavy}}.
- Reproductive Structures: Inflorescence type exhibits a {{Flower Inflorescence|*Single Bloom, Umbel, Spike, Panicle, Catkin}} structure with a primary petal/bract coloration pattern matching {{Primary Color Spectrum: White / Cream | Yellow, Pink / Red, Blue / Purple, Green / Brown}}.

2. TOXICITY & HOUSEHOLD SAFETY PROFILING
- Hazard Level Assessment: Cross-reference morphologic indicators against vascular plant toxin databases. Evaluate structural risk parameters assuming accidental ingestion by a {{Target Subject|*Canine/Feline, Human Infant, Adult Human, Livestock}}.
- Actionable Mitigation Matrix: Outline explicit emergency toxicity management protocols, detailing the primary active chemical compound groups present (e.g., calcium oxalate crystals, steroidal saponins, cardiac glycosides).

3. ETHNOBOTANICAL & REGIONAL GROUNDING
- Geographic Localization: Cross-check taxonomy filters with regional ecological baselines assuming the coordinate sighting occurred within a {{Geographic Zone|*Florida Maritime Hammock, Appalachian Woodlands, High Desert Scrub, Pacific Northwest Rainforest}}.
- Practical Application: Detail documented historical or modern ethnobotanical, medicinal, or structural utility practices using a verification strictness setting of {{Data Matching Strictness|*Conservative/Verified, Moderate, Broad/Historical}}.

DISCLAIMER: Always append a bolded medical safety warning emphasizing that visual identification frameworks are strictly for educational analysis and absolute verification requires formal laboratory sample testing before handling or ingestion.
